page_title: COM 1-1 VEN | Como v Venezia 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' 1 - 1 Goal! Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jean Butez into the top right corner.
90+5' Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

90+5' Ivan Smolcic (Como) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Venezia.
90+3' Franco Carboni (Venezia) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
90+1' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
90+1' Jonathan Ikone (Como) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' The Venezia players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
86' The referee signals a substitution. Yannik Engelhardt (Como) is brought on as a substitute for Lucas Da Cunha.
86' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Nico Paz is replaced by Alieu Fadera (Como).
85' Franco Carboni (Venezia) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
82' Ivan Smolcic (Como) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
81' John Yeboah (Venezia) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Anastasios Douvikas (Como) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
79' 7:4 – this is the current number of shots on target.
76' Here is a change. Mirko Maric is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia).
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Franco Carboni (Venezia) for Alessio Zerbin.
76' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the left post. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.

75' Ionut Radu pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Alberto Dossena (Como) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
75' It seemed like Lucas Da Cunha (Como) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
73' Giovanni Ayroldi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Fali Cande (Venezia).
73' Here's the change. Assane Diao leaves the pitch and Anastasios Douvikas (Como) comes on as a substitute.
72' Mirko Maric (Venezia) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
69' Issa Doumbia (Venezia) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
67' The possession of the ball – 65:35.
64' Jay Idzes (Venezia) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
64' Como will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
63' The substitution has been made. John Yeboah (Venezia) has replaced Gaetano Oristanio.
63' Substitution. Alfred Duncan walks off the pitch and Issa Doumbia (Venezia) comes on as a substitute.
63' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Mikael Egill Ellertsson and he is replaced by Bjarki Bjarkason (Venezia).
61' Some great controlled play and passing from Como. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
58' Kike Perez (Venezia) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
55' Como hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
53' Half-chance! Assane Diao (Como) plays a pass into the box, but Ionut Radu reacts well to snuff out the attack.
53' Kike Perez (Venezia) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Jean Butez.
49' 1 - 0 Goal! Jonathan Ikone (Como) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:0.
49' Jonathan Ikone (Como) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
48' Como are seeing far more of the ball now.
46' Cesc Fabregas has made a change at the break. Jonathan Ikone has come on in place of Gabriel Strefezza (Como).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Fellipe Jack (Como) is replaced by Alberto Dossena.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Maxence Caqueret (Como) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails well wide of the left post.
44' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Venezia was in an offside position.
41' The corner from Kike Perez (Venezia) is cleared away by the defence.
40' Nico Paz (Como) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
37' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jean Butez intercepts the ball.
37' Venezia take a short corner kick.

36' What a great chance for Alfred Duncan (Venezia). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
36' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) will take the corner.
36' Kike Perez (Venezia) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

34' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
34' Fellipe Jack (Como) has tested the patience of referee Giovanni Ayroldi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
31' The resulting set piece from Como is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' A pass into the box finds Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Jean Butez denies him.
29' Venezia take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
29' Fellipe Jack (Como) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) outjumped his marker after a well-taken corner, but his header goes wide of the target.
26' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
25' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
23' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Alex Valle (Como), but the defence gets it clear.
22' Maximo Perrone (Como) latches on to the corner kick near the penalty spot, but his header only crashes against the left post! The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
21' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is about to take a corner kick.
21' A cross into the box from Alex Valle (Como) is cleared.
20' The Venezia players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
16' The Venezia players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
14' Assane Diao (Como) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
12' 76:24 – the latest ball possession ratio.
11' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Ionut Radu is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
10' The foul by Maxence Caqueret (Como) was seen by Giovanni Ayroldi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
9' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
8' A yellow-coloured card is received by Alfred Duncan (Venezia).
7' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' Alex Valle (Como) sends a cross into the box, but Ionut Radu comes off his line to gather the ball.
5' One of the players from Venezia times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
4' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
2' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) for his blatant foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Venezia will kick the game off.
Giovanni Ayroldi will referee today's match.
